from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
base=Path('docs/audits/sources/p4-vol10/yi-red-presence-v1')
v=json.loads((base/'validation.json').read_text())
assert sha(base/'README.md')==v['reportSha256']
assert sha(base/'red-results.json')==v['redResultsSha256']
# Reuse the unchanged 4.1 literal import scanner, with its @shared and ?raw handling.
ns={}
exec(json.loads(Path('docs/audits/sources/p4-vol10/yi-contract-v1/validation.json').read_text())['verificationPython'],ns)
assert 'shared/lunar/p4YiOperands.ts' not in ns['seen']
assert 'shared/lunar/p4YiOperands.test.ts' not in ns['seen']
red=json.loads((base/'red-results.json').read_text())
fixtures=json.loads(Path('docs/audits/sources/p4-vol10/yi-expected-v1/expected.json').read_text())['presenceFixtures']
resolved={f['id']:f for f in fixtures if f['expected']['outcome']!='unknown'}
assert red['failedTests']==len(red['failedAssertions'])==len(resolved)==828
assert red['passedTests']==len(red['passedAssertions'])==82
assert red['totalTests']==910
assert red['pendingTests']==red['todoTests']==red['unhandledOrCollectionFailures']==0
assert {r['fixtureId'] for r in red['failedAssertions']}==set(resolved)
assert len({r['han'] for r in red['failedAssertions']})==11
for r in red['failedAssertions']:
 assert r['expected']==resolved[r['fixtureId']]['expected']['outcome']
 assert r['received']=='unknown' and r['errorName']=='AssertionError'
 assert r['failureMessage'].startswith('AssertionError: '+r['fixtureId']+':')
 assert "expected 'unknown' to be '"+r['expected']+"'" in r['failureMessage']
assert sum(r['expected']=='present' for r in red['failedAssertions'])==260
assert sum(r['expected']=='absent' for r in red['failedAssertions'])==568
# The initial RED shell is retained in the report; the live provider may later evolve in 4.4.
assert hashlib.sha256(red['providerAtRed'].encode()).hexdigest()==red['providerSha256']
assert "return { presence: 'unknown' }" in red['providerAtRed']
assert v['checks']['regression']['tests']==198
print('PASS RED evidence: 828 assertion failures / 82 integrity passes; frozen sources and production isolation remain intact')
